title: Carrot tops pesto
intro: During my first visit in Ardèche, I was mindblown to discover (from Sam and Aurélie) that you could use carrot, radish (or many different kinds of veggies) tops to make a wonderful pesto. I will always remember Sam cutting carrot tops in record time with his special pesto knife!

ingMand.name: tops from one carrot (drier, tastier) or radish (moister, blander) plant

insSteps: Roast the nuts and add them to the blender. Give it a few pulses.
Optional: Blanch the tops for a few seconds to preserve their bright green color.
Carrot tops can be quite fibrous. Cut them into small pieces before adding them to the blender one handful at a time. Pulse in between each handful.
Add the radish tops to the blender in the same way.
If the mixture is too dry, add a bit of water.
Add the rest of the ingredients and blend everything.
If you want to save this pesto for later, it can be stored up to two weeks in the fridge (with enough olive oil on top).

notes: Using half radish tops and half carrot tops results in the best texture.
